question: During which years did Khalji dynasty ruled over Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1290 - 1320**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Khalji dynasty ruled over Delhi from **1290 to 1320**.
 
• It was one of the ruling dynasties of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• The Khalji dynasty is known for its expansionist policy and military conquests.
 
• Alauddin Khalji, one of the prominent rulers of this dynasty, is noted for his administrative and economic reforms.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Delhi Sultanate was a Muslim kingdom based mostly in Delhi that stretched over large parts of the Indian subcontinent for 320 years (1206–1526).
 
• The Sultanate is noted for being one of the few powers to repel an attack by the Mongol Empire and for enthroning one of the few female rulers in Islamic history, Razia Sultana.
 
• The Khalji dynasty was succeeded by the Tughlaq dynasty in 1320.
 
• The period of the Delhi Sultanate saw significant cultural, economic, and architectural developments.
